description: 1948 is the Year of the Earth Rat in the Chinese zodiac, from February 10, 1948 to January 28, 1949. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1948 is the Year of the Earth Rat, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 10, 1948 and ended on January 28, 1949, so people born in 1948 before Feb 10 belong to the Fire Pig year.

sections.heading: When the 1948 Earth Rat year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1948 Earth Rat year began at Lunar New Year on February 10, 1948 and lasted until January 28, 1949, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 10 1948 therefore belongs to the Fire Pig year that started in 1947, while someone born in early 1949, up to Jan 28, is still a Earth Rat. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Earth Rat combination also falls in 2008, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1948 fell on a Tuesday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Earth Rat personality
paragraphs: Prudent, realistic and protective of the family nest, the Earth Rat is the steadiest member of its sign. Earth contains the Rat's Water in the controlling cycle, which tradition reads as a quick mind given firm banks. People born in this year tend to build slowly, keep good accounts and enjoy a dry joke among friends. Fear of change is the trait they are most often advised to watch.

Earth sits at the centre of the five-element wheel, and an Earth year is traditionally said to give any animal steadiness, patience and a practical turn of mind. Descriptions associate it with reliability, honesty and a talent for holding things together, whether that means a family, a budget or a team in a difficult season. Earth-year people are often portrayed as grounded, fair and good at turning ideas into workable plans. The element is linked with nourishment and care, so it carries a quiet generosity. Its shadow, in most readings, is heaviness: worry, stubbornness and a reluctance to move until every risk has been weighed twice.

sections.heading: 1948 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits add up to 22, the master builder's number, kept whole and associated with large, practical plans. The digits of 1948 add up to 22. In the twelve-year cycle the Rat is the first animal, earthly branch Zi, with Water as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Earth, and in the five-element cycles earth controls Water. The year before was the Fire Pig and the year after is the Earth Ox.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Wu-Zi: Wu is the Earth heavenly stem and Zi is the Rat's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1948?
faq.answer: 1948 is the Year of the Earth Rat. It started on February 10, 1948 and ended on January 28, 1949.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1948?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 10. Born before February 10, 1948, you are a Fire Pig; born on or after it, you are a Earth Rat.

faq.question: What element is 1948 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Earth, a Yang year. The Rat's own fixed element is Water; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1948?
faq.answer: Wu-Zi. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Earth Rat year?
faq.answer: 2008, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2008.
